# @uni-design-system/uni-angular — API reference

> Generated from source by scripts/generate-api.mjs (pnpm docs:api). Do not edit by hand.

Themed Angular component library. Signals-only API: every input below is a
signal input — read as `component.name()`, bind as `[name]="..."`. Two-way
model inputs support `[(name)]`. Form controls implement Signal Forms
`FormValueControl`/`FormCheckboxControl` and bind with `[field]`.

Import everything from `@uni-design-system/uni-angular`.
Canonical selectors are the `uni-`-prefixed form; the short/PascalCase
aliases (e.g. `Checkbox`, `button[text-button]`) are supported secondaries.

Inheritance (inputs listed once, available on all subclasses):
- Components extending `BaseComponent` also accept `variant: Variant` and `size: Size`.
- Layout components (`UniBoxComponent` and subclasses Row, Stack, Center, Wrap, Grid,
  MenuItem) also accept every `UniBoxComponent` input (padding*, border*, color,
  display, gap, width/height, flex/grid props, ...).

## BodyRenderDirective
- selector: `[uniBodyRender]`

## ConfirmationDialogComponent
- selector: `uni-confirmation-dialog`
- inputs:
  - `show: boolean` = false
  - `confirmation: Confirmation`
- outputs:
  - `showing: boolean`

## DragAndDropDirective
- selector: `[uni-drag-n-drop], [dragAndDrop]`
- outputs:
  - `onFileDropped: FileList`

## NotificationsComponent
- selector: `uni-notifications`

## RippleDirective
- selector: `[uniRipple]`

## UniAlertComponent
- selector: `uni-alert`
- inputs:
  - `iconName: IconName | undefined` = undefined
  - `symbolName: string | undefined` = undefined
  - `useVariant: boolean` = false
- two-way models:
  - `show: boolean`
- outputs:
  - `showing: boolean`

## UniAppBarComponent
- selector: `uni-app-bar`
- inputs:
  - `title: string` — Bar title; alternatively project your own center content.
  - `sticky: boolean` = false — Stick the bar to the top of its scroll container.

## UniAvatarComponent
- selector: `uni-avatar`
- inputs:
  - `src: string` — Image URL; on load error the avatar falls back to initials/symbol.
  - `name: string` — Person's name: drives the initials and the accessible label.
  - `text: string` — Verbatim text instead of derived initials (e.g. a group's “+3”).

## UniAvatarGroupComponent
- selector: `uni-avatar-group`
- inputs:
  - `max: number | undefined` = undefined — Show at most this many avatars; the rest collapse into a “+N” chip.

## UniBackgroundComponent
- selector: `uni-background`
- inputs:
  - `image: string`
  - `imagePosition: ImagePosition`
  - `imageSize: 'cover' | 'contain' | number | string`
  - `height: number | string` = '100%'
  - `width: number | string`

## UniBadgeComponent
- selector: `[uni-badge]`
- inputs:
  - `color: Variant | undefined` = undefined
  - `useVariant: boolean` = false
  - `width: number`

## UniBoxDirective
- selector: `[uni-box-layout], [box-layout]`
- inputs:
  - `color: ContainerColorToken`
  - `backgroundColor: OptionalColor`
  - `borderRadius: OptionalRadius`
  - `borderRadiusLeft: OptionalRadius`
  - `borderRadiusRight: OptionalRadius`
  - `borderRadiusTop: OptionalRadius`
  - `borderRadiusBottom: OptionalRadius`
  - `padding: OptionalSize`
  - `paddingHorizontal: OptionalSize`
  - `paddingVertical: OptionalSize`
  - `paddingLeft: OptionalSize`
  - `paddingRight: OptionalSize`
  - `paddingTop: OptionalSize`
  - `paddingBottom: OptionalSize`
  - `border: OptionalBorder`
  - `borderTop: OptionalBorder`
  - `borderBottom: OptionalBorder`
  - `borderLeft: OptionalBorder`
  - `borderRight: OptionalBorder`
  - `dashBorder: boolean` = false
  - `alignSelf: OptionalAlignSelf`
  - `alignItems: OptionalAlignItems`
  - `alignContent: OptionalAlignContent`
  - `justifyContent: OptionalJustifyContent`
  - `grow: number`
  - `flex: number | string` — The `flex` shorthand. `[flex]="1"` is `flex: 1` — grow, shrink and a zero basis — which `grow` alone cannot express, since it leaves `flex-basis: auto`. Wins over `grow` when both are set.
  - `shrink: number`
  - `basis: number | string`
  - `marginInline: 'auto' | NullableSize` — Inline-axis margin. `marginInline="auto"` centers a `maxWidth` container — the one thing flex centering cannot do without an extra wrapper. Only the inline axis is exposed: block margins collapse and fight `gap`, which is why the primitives carry no margin otherwise.
  - `display: OptionalDisplay`
  - `position: OptionalPosition`
  - `inset: number | string`
  - `height: number | string` — Number = px via binding (`[height]="420"`); string = CSS length (`height="420px"`).
  - `minHeight: number | string`
  - `maxHeight: number | string`
  - `width: number | string` — Number = px via binding (`[width]="420"`); string = CSS length (`width="50%"`).
  - `minWidth: number | string`
  - `maxWidth: number | string`
  - `ignoreDir: boolean` = true
  - `gridArea: string`
  - `gridColumn: string`
  - `gridRow: string`
  - `overflow: OptionalOverflow`
  - `shadow: Shadow`
  - `gap: OptionalSize`
  - `fullWidth: boolean`
  - `fullHeight: boolean`
  - `flexDirection: OptionalFlexDirection`
  - `textAlign: OptionalTextAlign`
  - `wrapItems: OptionalWrap` = undefined
  - `zIndex: ZIndexableElements`

## UniBreadcrumbComponent
- selector: `uni-breadcrumb`
- inputs:
  - `items: BreadcrumbItem[]` (required) — The trail, root first; the last item is the current page.
  - `ariaLabel: string` = 'Breadcrumb' — Landmark label distinguishing this nav from others on the page.
- outputs:
  - `itemClicked: BreadcrumbItem` — Emits the clicked ancestor item (also fires for `href` links).

- inputs:
  - `disable: boolean | undefined` = false
  - `loading: boolean | undefined` = false
  - `fullWidth: boolean` = false
  - `symbolLeft: string`
  - `symbolRight: string`

## UniButtonGroupComponent
- selector: `uni-button-group`

## UniCalendarComponent
- selector: `uni-calendar, Calendar`
- inputs:
  - `disabled: boolean` = false
  - `invalid: boolean` = false
  - `dirty: boolean` = false
  - `required: boolean` = false
  - `ariaDescribedBy: string`
  - `mode: UniCalendarMode` = 'single' — `'single'` reads/writes a `UniDate`; `'range'` a `UniDateRange`.
  - `minDate: UniDate` — Earliest selectable date (inclusive).
  - `maxDate: UniDate` — Latest selectable date (inclusive).
  - `markers: UniCalendarMarker[]` = [] — Availability dots; `label` extends the day's accessible name.
  - `locale: string` — BCP 47 tag; defaults to the document language, then the browser's.
  - `weekStart: 0 | 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5 | 6` — First day of week, 0 = Sunday; defaults from the locale's week info.
  - `ariaLabel: string` — Names the grid when it stands alone (otherwise the heading names it).
  - `size: Size` = 'md' — Day geometry token; `sm`/`md`/`lg` map to the theme's `calendar` sizes.
- two-way models:
  - `value: UniCalendarValue`
  - `touched: boolean` = false
  - `month: string` — Shown month, `'YYYY-MM'` — two-way, so an app can drive "jump to June".
- outputs:
  - `selected: UniDate` — Each committed day, including both ends of a range.

## UniCalloutComponent
- selector: `uni-callout`
- inputs:
  - `key: string` — Identifies this callout in `dismissed` payloads. Empty string = unset.
  - `target: HTMLElement | string` — Element (or id, resolved at open time) to spotlight. '' = unset.
  - `placement: Placement` = 'bottom'
  - `backdrop: 'spotlight' | 'dim' | 'none'` — Defaults to `spotlight` when a target resolves, else `dim`.
  - `targetInteractive: boolean` = true — When false, a transparent cover blocks the spotlit target.
  - `dismissible: boolean` = true — Gates Escape and the close button.
  - `dismissOnBackdrop: boolean` = false — When true, scrim clicks close (reason `backdrop`); else the panel pulses.
  - `header: string`
  - `arrow: boolean` = true
  - `ariaLabel: string` — Wins over the header/body labelling; the tour sets "{title}, step n of N".
  - `closeLabel: string` = 'Close' — Accessible name of the dismiss button (the tour passes its skip label).
- two-way models:
  - `open: boolean` = false
- outputs:
  - `opened: void`
  - `closed: void`
  - `dismissed: UniCalloutDismissal`
  - `panelKeydown: KeyboardEvent` — Keys pressed while focus is inside the panel (the tour's arrow-key hook).

## UniCenterDirective
- selector: `[uni-center-layout], [center-layout]`

## UniCheckboxComponent
- selector: `uni-checkbox`
- inputs:
  - `disabled: boolean` = false
  - `invalid: boolean` = false
  - `dirty: boolean` = false
  - `required: boolean` = false — Synced from required() validators by the Signal Forms [field] directive.
  - `ariaDescribedBy: string` — Id(s) of external element(s) describing this control — typically your app-rendered error message — exposed as aria-describedby.
  - `label: string`
- two-way models:
  - `checked: boolean` = false
  - `touched: boolean` = false
  - `indeterminate: boolean` = false — Mixed state for "select all"-style parent checkboxes. Cleared automatically on the next user interaction, matching native behavior.

## UniComboboxComponent
- selector: `uni-combobox, Combobox`
- inputs:
  - `disabled: boolean` = false
  - `invalid: boolean` = false
  - `dirty: boolean` = false
  - `required: boolean` = false
  - `ariaDescribedBy: string`
  - `label: string` (required) — Accessible name for the field, e.g. "State"; echoed on the listbox.
  - `placeholder: string`
  - `options: Options<T>` = []
  - `width: string | number` = '100%'
  - `clearable: boolean` = true — Show a ✕ while a value is set; an emptied field on blur also clears.
  - `commitOnBlur: boolean` = true — Blur commits an exact-match draft; a non-matching draft reverts.
  - `emptyText: string` = 'No matches' — i18n-able empty row, also announced when a filter matches nothing.
  - `filterLocally: boolean` = true — `false` renders `options` verbatim; narrow them app-side from `query`.
  - `debounceTime: number` = 250
- two-way models:
  - `value: T | null` = null
  - `touched: boolean` = false
- outputs:
  - `query: string` — Debounced draft text, for async option lists.
  - `selected: Option<T>` — An option committed.
  - `cleared: void`
  - `rejected: UniComboboxRejection` — A commit was refused (no match); the field reverted.

  - `placeholder: string` = 'Search'

  - `columns: ColumnDefinition<T>[]` (required)
  - `useMultiSelect: boolean` = false
  - `useRowClick: boolean` = true
  - `height: string`
- outputs:
  - `rowSelect: T`
  - `rowClick: T`

## UniDateInputComponent
- selector: `uni-date-input, DateInput`
- inputs:
  - `disabled: boolean` = false
  - `invalid: boolean` = false
  - `dirty: boolean` = false
  - `required: boolean` = false
  - `ariaDescribedBy: string`
  - `label: string` (required) — Accessible name for the field, e.g. "Appointment date".
  - `placeholder: string` — Defaults to the locale's digit pattern, e.g. `MM/DD/YYYY`.
  - `displayFormat: Intl.DateTimeFormatOptions` = { dateStyle: 'medium' } — How the committed value renders, e.g. `{ dateStyle: 'long' }`.
  - `locale: string` — BCP 47 tag; defaults to the document language, then the browser's.
  - `commitOnBlur: boolean` = true
  - `embedded: boolean` = false — Renders without its own input-box chrome, for composers like uni-date-time-input.
  - `minDate: UniDate`
  - `maxDate: UniDate`
  - `markers: UniCalendarMarker[]` = []
  - `weekStart: 0 | 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5 | 6`
- two-way models:
  - `value: UniDate | undefined`
  - `touched: boolean` = false
- outputs:
  - `opened: void` — Popup shown.
  - `closed: void` — Popup hidden.
  - `rejected: UniDateInputRejection` — A typed commit was refused; the raw text stays in the field.

## UniDateTimeInputComponent
- selector: `uni-date-time-input, DateTimeInput`
- inputs:
  - `disabled: boolean` = false
  - `invalid: boolean` = false
  - `dirty: boolean` = false
  - `required: boolean` = false
  - `ariaDescribedBy: string`
  - `label: string` (required) — Names the group; the parts are announced as "Date" and "Time" under it.
  - `minDateTime: UniDateTime` — Earliest allowed moment; the date and time fences are split from it.
  - `maxDateTime: UniDateTime` — Latest allowed moment; the date and time fences are split from it.
  - `markers: UniCalendarMarker[]` = []
  - `slots: UniTime[]` — Fixed time choices; superseded per-day by `slotsFor` when that is set.
  - `minuteStep: number` = 30
  - `hour12: boolean`
  - `weekStart: 0 | 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5 | 6`
  - `locale: string`
- two-way models:
  - `value: UniDateTime | undefined`
  - `touched: boolean` = false

  - `autocomplete: string`

  - `role: string`
  - `ariaExpanded: boolean | undefined` = undefined
  - `ariaControls: string`
  - `ariaActivedescendant: string`
- outputs:

## UniDialogComponent
- selector: `dialog[uni-dialog]`
- inputs:
  - `ariaLabel: string` — Accessible name for dialogs without a DialogHeader. When a DialogHeader is present it labels the dialog automatically via aria-labelledby.
  - `initialFocus: string` — CSS selector for the element to focus when the dialog opens. Defaults to the browser's native behavior (first focusable element).
  - `defaultCloseButton: boolean`
- two-way models:
  - `show: boolean` = false — Two-way bindable open state: [(show)].
- outputs:
  - `showing: boolean` — Emits true once opened and false once the closing animation finishes.

## UniDropdownComponent
- selector: `uni-dropdown`
- inputs:
  - `trigger: HTMLElement` (required)
  - `placement: Placement` = 'bottom-start'
  - `offset: AnchorOffset` = { mainAxis: 4, alignmentAxis: 12 }
  - `ariaHasPopup: AriaHasPopup | null` = null — Value for aria-haspopup on the trigger, describing what the popover contains (e.g. 'menu' for Menu, 'dialog' for rich content). When unset, only aria-expanded/aria-controls are managed.
  - `paddingVertical: NullableSize`
  - `paddingHorizontal: NullableSize`
  - `border: Border | undefined`
  - `borderRadius: Radius | undefined`
  - `shadow: Shadow | undefined`
  - `color: ContainerColorToken | undefined`
- outputs:
  - `dropdownShowing: boolean`
  - `dropdownHiding: boolean`

## UniExpandAreaComponent
- selector: `uni-expand-area`
- inputs:
  - `title: string` (required)
  - `initCollapsed: unknown` = false, { transform: booleanAttribute }
  - `padding: NullableSize` = 'md'
- outputs:
  - `collapsed: boolean`

## UniExpandComponent
- selector: `uni-expand`
- inputs:
  - `transitionSpeed: number` — Exact per-instance duration in seconds. Bypasses size-aware scaling — an explicit number means the consumer wants that number. Omitted, the duration derives from the `expand` theme options' `transitionSpeed` scaled by content height (see `duration`).
- two-way models:
  - `collapsed: boolean` = true

## UniExpandToggleComponent
- selector: `uni-expand-toggle`
- inputs:
  - `ariaControls: string` — Id of the Expand region this toggle controls (see UniExpandComponent.regionId).
  - `label: string` — Names the region. Setting it switches the toggle to its labelled shape.
  - `sublabel: string` — Muted qualifier beside the label ("for POs & custom orders"). Needs `label`.
  - `transitionSpeed: number` — Rotation duration in seconds. Expand Area binds the region's resolved `duration` here so chevron and reveal share one clock even when the region is size-scaled or overridden per instance.
- two-way models:
  - `collapsed: boolean` = true

  - `browseButtonText: string` = 'Browse for file'
  - `allowedFileExtensions: string[]` = []
  - `label: string`
  - `helpTemplate: TemplateRef<unknown> | null` = null
  - `helpTemplateContext: unknown | null` = null
- outputs:
  - `fileAttached: File | undefined`
  - `fileRemoved: unknown`

## UniIconButtonComponent
- selector: `button[uni-icon-button], button[icon-button]`
- inputs:
  - `ariaLabel: string` — Accessible name for the button. Alternative to projecting text content (`<button icon-button>Close</button>`); one of the two is required for an icon-only button to be announced correctly.
  - `iconName: IconName`
  - `symbolName: string`
  - `variant: Variant` = 'ghost'
  - `size: Size` = 'lg'
  - `disable: boolean`
  - `loading: boolean`
  - `opticalSize: number` = 24

## UniIconComponent
- selector: `uni-icon`
- inputs:
  - `color: ColorToken`
  - `name: IconName` (required)
  - `size: CssLength` — Explicit square size. Bare numbers are px; strings pass through, so any CSS length works (`'1.25rem'`, `'1em'`, `'clamp(…)'`). Leave it unset to keep the default behaviour — the icon fills its container, which is what lets a themed control size its own glyph through padding. Set it at call sites that would otherwise need a width/height rule just to size one icon.

## UniInputBoxComponent
- selector: `uni-input-box`
- inputs:
  - `disabled: boolean` = false
  - `error: boolean` = false
  - `minWidth: string` = '0'
  - `height: string | number | undefined` = undefined — Override the themed field height, e.g. `'auto'` for multi-line fields.
  - `width: string | number | undefined` = undefined
  - `fullWidth: boolean` = false
  - `grow: number | undefined` = undefined

## UniInputComponent
- selector: `uni-input`
- inputs:
  - `disabled: boolean` = false
  - `invalid: boolean` = false
  - `dirty: boolean` = false
  - `required: boolean` = false — Synced from required() validators by the Signal Forms [field] directive.
  - `ariaDescribedBy: string` — Id(s) of external element(s) describing this control — typically your app-rendered error message — exposed as aria-describedby.
  - `label: string` (required)
  - `placeholder: string` = ''
  - `type: UniInputType` = 'text' — Native input type. Text-like types only — `date`/`time` have dedicated components, and non-text types break the input chrome and the string value.
  - `readonly: boolean` = false
  - `name: string` = ''
  - `min: number | undefined` = undefined
  - `max: number | undefined` = undefined
  - `minLength: number | undefined` = undefined
  - `maxLength: number | undefined` = undefined
  - `pattern: readonly RegExp[]` = [] — Patterns the value must match — all of them, per Signal Forms. The native `pattern` attribute can only express one, so it is reflected only when there is exactly one; Signal Forms validates the rest either way.
  - `step: number | string` — Granularity for `type="number"`, e.g. `0.01` or `'any'`.
  - `autocomplete: string` — Autofill hint, e.g. `email`, `current-password`, `off`.
  - `inputMode: UniInputMode` — On-screen keyboard hint; defaults to whatever `type` implies.
  - `list: string` — Id of a `<datalist>` supplying suggestions.
  - `spellcheck: boolean`
  - `width: string | number | undefined` = undefined
  - `fullWidth: boolean` = false
  - `grow: number | undefined` = undefined
- two-way models:
  - `value: string` = ''
  - `touched: boolean` = false

## UniMultiSelectDropdownComponent
- selector: `uni-multi-select-dropdown`
- inputs:
  - `disabled: boolean` = false
  - `invalid: boolean` = false
  - `dirty: boolean` = false
  - `required: boolean` = false — Synced from required() validators by the Signal Forms [field] directive.
  - `ariaDescribedBy: string` — Id(s) of external element(s) describing this control — typically your app-rendered error message — exposed as aria-describedby.
  - `options: Options<T>` (required)
  - `placeholder: string` = ''
  - `label: string` — What the field is for, e.g. "Fruits". Rendered visually hidden inside the trigger so its accessible name reads "Fruits, Apple, Pear" — without it a screen reader announces only the current selection, with no clue which field it belongs to.
  - `debounceTime: number` = 200 — Debounce for the filter box, matching the library's input debounce.
- two-way models:
  - `value: T[]` = []
  - `touched: boolean` = false

## UniNotificationBadgeComponent
- selector: `uni-notification-badge`
- inputs:
  - `count: number | undefined` = undefined
  - `maxCount: number` = 99
  - `badgeVariant: 'dot' | 'count' | 'pill'` = 'count'
  - `color: Variant | undefined` = undefined
  - `position: 'top-right' | 'top-left' | 'bottom-right' | 'bottom-left'` = 'top-right'
  - `show: boolean` = true
  - `ariaLabel: string` — Screen-reader text for the badge (e.g. "5 unread messages"). Without it a sensible default is announced; a bare number or dot carries no meaning.

## UniPopoverComponent
- selector: `uni-popover`
- inputs:
  - `placement: Placement` = 'bottom'
  - `autoClose: boolean` = true — Light-dismiss on outside click / Escape (native popover="auto").
  - `mode: 'rich' | 'tooltip'` = 'rich' — `rich` = click-toggled disclosure; `tooltip` = hover/focus description.
  - `anchor: HTMLElement | string` — Anchor the panel to another element (or element id, resolved each time the panel opens) while the projected trigger keeps the disclosure ARIA. Empty string means unset.
  - `header: string` — Title rendered in the header row and used as the accessible name.
  - `closable: boolean` = false — Renders a "Close" icon button in the header row.
  - `arrow: boolean` = true
  - `maxWidth: string | number` — Panel max-width; numbers are px. Defaults to the theme's `maxWidth`.
  - `openDelay: number` — Tooltip-mode hover-open delay, ms; defaults to the theme option.
  - `closeDelay: number` — Tooltip-mode pointer-leave close delay, ms; defaults to the theme option.
- two-way models:
  - `open: boolean` = false — Two-way open state; light dismissal and hover timers sync back into it.
- outputs:
  - `opened: void`
  - `closed: void`

  - `height: number` = 24

## UniSkeletonComponent
- selector: `uni-skeleton`
- inputs:
  - `shape: SkeletonShape` = 'text'
  - `width: string | number | undefined` = undefined — CSS width; defaults to 100% for text/rect and `height` for circles.
  - `height: string | number | undefined` = undefined — CSS height per block; defaults to 1em (text), 96px (rect), 40px (circle).
  - `lines: number` = 1 — Number of text lines (text shape only).
  - `color: ColorKey | undefined` = undefined — Base color token; overrides the theme option for this skeleton.
  - `highlightColor: ColorKey | undefined` = undefined — Shimmer highlight token; overrides the theme option for this skeleton.
  - `borderRadius: Radius | undefined` = undefined — Radius token; overrides the theme option. Circles are always round.
  - `label: string | undefined` = undefined — Announces the skeleton to assistive tech as a polite status. Leave unset when a container already carries `aria-busy` — the skeleton then stays `aria-hidden`, as a decorative placeholder should.

## UniStatComponent
- selector: `uni-stat`
- inputs:
  - `label: string` (required) — What is being measured, sentence case.
  - `value: string | number` (required) — The headline number: strings render verbatim, numbers auto-compact.
  - `delta: string` — Signed change, e.g. "+12.4%" or "-0.4%". The sign drives the arrow.
  - `upIsGood: boolean` = true — Whether an upward movement is good news. Flip for churn, errors, cost.
  - `caption: string` — Names the comparison period, e.g. "vs last month".
  - `trend: number[] | undefined` = undefined — Recent values for the decorative sparkline (12 points reads best).

## UniTagComponent
- selector: `uni-tag`
- inputs:
  - `size: Size` = 'md'
  - `tone: TagTone` = 'soft'
  - `label: string`
  - `value: string | number`
  - `maxWidth: string | number` — Truncation budget, e.g. `'14ch'`. A number is treated as px.
  - `avatarSrc: string`
  - `avatarName: string` — Initials fallback when `avatarSrc` is absent or fails to load.
  - `iconName: IconName` — Theme icon primitive — the preferred glyph path.
  - `symbolName: string` — Material Symbols ligature, for glyphs the theme's icon set doesn't carry.
  - `dot: boolean` = false — Status dot in the current colour.
  - `removable: boolean` = false
  - `interactive: boolean` = false
  - `selected: boolean | undefined` = undefined — Toggle state. Left undefined the chip carries no `aria-pressed` at all — an interactive chip is not always a toggle (inside a tag input it is focusable so it can be removed), and announcing "not pressed" on a recipient chip is worse than announcing nothing.
  - `invalid: boolean` = false
  - `disabled: boolean` = false
  - `removeLabel: string` — Accessible-name override for the remove button.
  - `controlTabIndex: number` = 0 — Tab position of the chip's controls. A composite that owns its own roving focus — `uni-tag-input`, where the whole field is one tab stop — passes `-1` so Tab does not walk through every chip to reach the next control.
- outputs:
  - `removed: UniTagValue`
  - `activated: UniTagValue`

## UniTagInputComponent
- selector: `uni-tag-input`
- inputs:
  - `disabled: boolean` = false
  - `invalid: boolean` = false
  - `dirty: boolean` = false
  - `required: boolean` = false
  - `ariaDescribedBy: string`
  - `label: string` (required) — Accessible name for the field, e.g. "To".
  - `placeholder: string`
  - `preset: 'text' | 'email'` = 'text' — `email` wires an address validator, paste parser and space separator.
  - `separators: string[]` = [',', ';']
  - `commitOnBlur: boolean` = true
  - `allowDuplicates: boolean` = false
  - `max: number`
  - `tagVariant: Variant` = 'primary'
  - `tagTone: TagTone` = 'soft'
  - `tagSize: Size`
  - `suggestions: UniTagSuggestion[]` = []
  - `debounceTime: number` = 250
- two-way models:
  - `value: UniTagItem[]` = []
  - `touched: boolean` = false
- outputs:
  - `query: string` — Debounced text the app should filter `suggestions` from.
  - `added: UniTagItem`
  - `removed: UniTagItem`
  - `rejected: UniTagRejection`

## UniTextDirective
- selector: `[uni-text]`
- inputs:
  - `uniText: Typeface | ''` = '', { alias: 'uni-text' } — Typeface via the selector attribute: `uni-text="headline-large"`.
  - `typeface: Typeface | undefined` = undefined — Explicit typeface; the attribute value wins when both are set.
  - `color: ColorKey`
  - `textColor: ColorKey` — The ink color, unambiguously. `color` is also an input on the layout directives, where it means a *container* pair (background plus its on-color). On an element carrying both — `<div row-layout uni-text>` — one `color` binding feeds both directives, so the text and the background resolve to the same token and the text disappears. Use `textColor` there; it wins over `color`.
  - `display: OptionalDisplay`
  - `align: OptionalTextAlign`
  - `nowrap: boolean`
  - `maxWidth: number`
  - `ellipsis: boolean` = false

## UniTimeInputComponent
- selector: `uni-time-input, TimeInput`
- inputs:
  - `disabled: boolean` = false
  - `invalid: boolean` = false
  - `dirty: boolean` = false
  - `required: boolean` = false
  - `ariaDescribedBy: string`
  - `label: string` (required) — Accessible name for the field, e.g. "Start time".
  - `placeholder: string`
  - `minuteStep: number` = 30 — Generated list granularity, in minutes.
  - `minTime: UniTime` — Earliest allowed time (inclusive), `'09:00'`.
  - `maxTime: UniTime` — Latest allowed time (inclusive), `'17:00'`.
  - `slots: UniTime[]` — Exact allowed times (scheduling). When set, typed entry must match one.
  - `hour12: boolean` — 12-hour display; defaults from the locale. The value stays 24-hour.
  - `locale: string` — BCP 47 tag for the display format; defaults to the document language.
  - `commitOnBlur: boolean` = true
  - `embedded: boolean` = false — Renders without its own input-box chrome, for composers like uni-date-time-input.
- two-way models:
  - `value: UniTime | undefined`
  - `touched: boolean` = false
- outputs:
  - `rejected: UniTimeInputRejection` — A typed commit was refused; the raw text stays in the field.
